"May the Holy Light protect us on our expedition to the frozen north."
"I really wish you mages would get your heads out from inside your own... books."
"May my sisters realize their full potential, the name Windrunner known as a result of their deeds."
"Grant me the strength to accept the things that I cannot change, the courage to change the things I can, and the wisdom to know the difference."
"Oh, why won't you notice me? Abbendis, I would follow you anywhere. I wish you would notice me..."
"I pray that when the time comes, I will have the strength to thwart the forces beyond the gate."
"How does this fountain even work? I wonder if I could make one."
"Turalyon and Alleria, wherever you are, may you be well."
"May my son Arthas always act in the best interest of his people."
"<You sense the ringing of three tones in your head, the third barely audible under the others' din.>"
"I hope that my father and brothers outlive me. I'll not make much of a king."
"I wish I would grow up, it feels like I've been 10 for years."
"Young Arthas must learn patience to temper his power. I will pray that he one day learns how to lead with care rather than force."
"Already, I've a kingdom in my prospects, a land to rule. What to ask for? Perhaps a frozen scone..."
"I wish someday to retire to my own tidy little estate, with a bunch of pet dogs to keep me company."
"Sometimes... I wish someone would come along and just give me a big, long hug."
"Arthas, my love, please come back to me."
"Listen, little wishing fountain. You'll give me all your power if you know what's good for you."
"I hope my sisters and I can grow up and get married together. This coin appears to be very old."
"It is my wish that my dear Taelan will grow strong enough to defend the people he cares for."
"I wish to know how you survived my wrath, little fountain."
"Explain my dreams, little fountain. Why must I always be viewing my kin from above and moving them like pawns?"
"It seems my moonlighting days as a postal worker are coming to an end."
"Grom, may you rest well, old friend."
"This doesn't make sense. Why am I putting a coin in a fountain?"
"The amount of coins shining in the pool. Maybe no one will notice if I take just one."
"Wish I had that cousin of mine's duty to do nothing more than lug wood around carelessly..."
"I wish Captain Sanders would hurry up with my shipment of wine."
"I wish for happiness and acceptance for my daughter. She feels so out of place here..."
"Can I have a more comfortable saddle? My hindquarters ache."
"I hope a troll dies, right... NOW."
"Being a rogue is hard work. Someday I hope to pursue my life's one true passion..."
"I hope I end up in another book eventually."
"I wish I had my father back..."
"I wish people would stop knocking my toys off the shelf."
"I could have used this copper for something productive. Perhaps something with string and a machine."
"How does a tavern run out of ale!"
"I miss my sword and shield. I feel so naked without my sword and shield."
"Here you go, Nozdormu. What was I supposed to do after this?"
"How do I prove they copied us with this fountain?"
